briefing.headline: xAI Colossus-2 and OpenAI Orion-2 escalate AGI capabilities race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while US-China compute restrictions tightened. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing in infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI deployed Colossus-2 with 1.2T parameters; OpenAI's Orion-2 achieved new multimodal benchmarks. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and Google Gemini 3.1 entered limited preview.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell production ramp reached 400k units monthly. Microsoft and CoreWeave announced $4B joint data center expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will coordinated multi-agent oversight frameworks emerge before a 10x capability jump?
